module rtlpp_05885 (
    output [4:0] clk,
    input [1:0] inclk
);

// Signals
wire [4:0] wire_pll1_clk;
wire wire_pll1_fbout;

// Replace instantiation of cycloneive_pll with internal logic
reg [4:0] clk_reg;
reg fbout_reg;

// PLL behavior (simplified example)
always @(posedge inclk[0] or negedge inclk[0]) begin
    clk_reg[0] <= inclk[0];
    clk_reg[1] <= inclk[0];
    clk_reg[2] <= inclk[0];
    clk_reg[3] <= inclk[0];
    clk_reg[4] <= inclk[0];
    fbout_reg <= inclk[0];
end

// Assign output clocks
assign wire_pll1_clk = clk_reg;
assign wire_pll1_fbout = fbout_reg;

assign clk = wire_pll1_clk;

endmodule
